acceptance: Comparable fixture benchmark covers tiny objects, similar versions, recovery and GC across filesystem, SQLite and commodity S3; ZEROS3 is recorded as not measured until an endpoint exists (VSF-B18-T07); record actual numbers.

positive.fixture: seeded corpus and workload runner over all three backends, kill -9 child and server crash runs, chunk-dedup analysis

negative.fixture: zero acknowledged writes lost, corrupt or torn across the crash runs; percentile summaries checked against known inputs; corpus deterministic and content addressed

versions.primitive: No contract change; one third-party dependency added (modernc.org/sqlite), see ADR-038.

security_and_source_permissions: Benchmark objects are synthetic; no account data.
performance_memory_storage: 200,000 tiny objects and 200 similar 512 KiB versions on one machine; recorded in docs/deep/evidence/VSF-B13/storage-benchmark.md (tiny read p50: fs 0.03 ms, sqlite 0.23, s3 1.9; device writes per logical byte: fs 4.3x, sqlite 33.3x, s3 8.7x; whole-object versions 1.00x).
known_limitations: ZEROS3 not measured: no endpoint, credentials or client exist (VSF-B18-T07)
One machine and a synthetic corpus; real compiled artifacts may share more or less than the 37% chunk-dedup estimate
